stages.G1 collapse: a page whose text is >= 0.5 shared (dup_members shared_chars / page characters; SAME_WORK_COPY, REPRINT, SHARED_ABSTRACT) with a better-ranked page leaves and is listed on it (copies); objects by object_dup_members (BOILERPLATE never); last step
stages.G2 cohesion: >= 2 of the first 10 pages (after late) in one deep NAV section (level >= 2, <= 16 pages): its other pages (nearest to the hits, <= 4 per section, <= 12) fused after late
stages.G3 concepts: synonyms and abbreviations of the term dictionary (score >= 0.8; OCR spelling variants skipped) replace the query's phrases, optionally a narrower term of the main concept: <= 2 wordings, BM25 only
stages.G4 cites: sources cited by / citing the works of the RRF top-10 sources (canon CITES): BM25 over their pages
stages.G5 topics: level-1 NAV topics holding >= 2 of the first 10 pages: E's later pages in those topics' sections are lifted (no new page)
stages.fusion: never inside E's RRF; post = first 10 positions kept, the rest fused by weighted RRF (k 60, E wins ties); window = the leg widens the late window and MaxSim decides
stages.gates: late stage required (SKIPPED_LATE_OFF); without NAV: E's answer, status UNAVAILABLE, a warning only when the request named the stages
